课程简介（中文）

阿拉伯伊斯兰文化是人类文明体系中持续发展的重要组成部分之一，作为世界四大未断代文化传统之一，它在历史长河中形成了独特的宗教信仰、语言体系、艺术表达、哲学思想与社会制度。本课程旨在通过系统的学术探究，引导学生深入理解阿拉伯伊斯兰文化的形成、演变及其对全球文明的影响。

本课程以历史发展为主线，依循起源、发展、转型、现代化与全球化的脉络，探讨阿拉伯伊斯兰文化的内在结构、变迁动力及跨文化互动。课程内容涵盖伊斯兰教兴起前的阿拉伯文化、伊斯兰文明的建立与鼎盛、殖民主义影响下的文化变革、现代民族国家的形成，以及当代阿拉伯文化在全球化进程中的角色。通过对历史文献、学术研究、多语种（阿拉伯语、英语、法语、中文）文本、影音资料的分析，学生将掌握研究阿拉伯伊斯兰文化的多重途径，拓展对世界文明体系的整体认知。

此外，课程将结合东方学理论、跨文化研究、全球化视角，深入探讨阿拉伯世界与西方社会的关系，特别是法国、英国等前殖民国家对阿拉伯世界的影响，以及当代中阿关系在“一带一路”框架下的文化、经济与政治互动。通过跨学科的方法论训练，学生将能够批判性地分析阿拉伯伊斯兰文化的复杂性，理解其在历史与现代性之间的张力，并培养全球化时代下的文化理解与比较研究能力。

本课程适合对中东历史、伊斯兰文明感兴趣的学生，亦可为国际关系、历史学、人类学、宗教学等相关专业提供跨学科视角。课程强调学术研究与现实关照的结合，鼓励学生在课堂讨论、小组研究、案例分析等实践性教学环节中积极探索阿拉伯伊斯兰文化的多维特性。

课程简介（英文）

Arab Islamic culture constitutes one of the enduring components within the framework of human civilisation. As one of the world's four uninterrupted cultural traditions, it has developed distinctive religious beliefs, linguistic systems, artistic expressions, philosophical thought, and social institutions throughout history. This course aims to guide students towards a profound understanding of the formation, evolution, and global impact of Arab Islamic culture through systematic academic inquiry.
Following a historical trajectory, the course examines the origins, development, transformation, modernisation, and globalisation of Arab-Islamic culture, exploring its internal structure, driving forces of change, and cross-cultural interactions. Content encompasses pre-Islamic Arab culture, the establishment and zenith of Islamic civilisation, cultural transformations under colonialism, the formation of modern nation-states, and the role of contemporary Arab culture within globalisation. Through analysis of historical documents, academic research, multilingual texts (Arabic, English, French, Chinese), and audiovisual materials, students will master multiple approaches to studying Arab-Islamic culture, broadening their holistic understanding of world civilisational systems.
Furthermore, the programme integrates Orientalist theory, cross-cultural studies, and global perspectives to examine the relationship between the Arab world and Western societies. Particular emphasis is placed on the influence of former colonial powers such as France and Britain on the Arab world, alongside contemporary Sino-Arab cultural, economic, and political interactions within the Belt and Road Initiative framework. Through interdisciplinary methodological training, students will develop the capacity for critical analysis of the complexities within Arab-Islamic culture, understanding its tensions between history and modernity, while cultivating skills in cultural comprehension and comparative research within the globalised era.
This course is suitable for students interested in Middle Eastern history and Islamic civilisation, while also offering an interdisciplinary perspective for those studying international relations, history, anthropology, religious studies, and related disciplines. Emphasising the integration of academic research with practical relevance, the course encourages students to actively explore the multidimensional nature of Arab-Islamic culture through classroom discussions, group research, case studies, and other practical teaching activities.

教学目标

本课程对学生作如下两点基本要求：

① 启发学生对阿拉伯伊斯兰文化有一个较为全面和深刻的认识，能够对当代阿拉伯世界的文化现象作出笔头或口头的原创性报告，洞察中东政治与热点问题背后的文化根源，提高对阿拉伯伊斯兰问题的独特思考能力。

② 具备一定的跨文化交际能力，能够正确认知他者文化，包括但不限于他者文化的实践、观念、和行为方式等，夯实跨文化交际能力，践行文明互鉴与跨文化沟通，促进中外青年一代的交流与交往。
